title.zh: 2026 值得关注的 AI Agent 开源项目
title.en: AI agent projects worth watching in 2026

intro.zh: AI Agent 是今年开源世界最拥挤的赛道，star 数只能告诉你什么在流行。我们更关心是谁在写代码：这份合集里的每个项目都附带核心贡献者的引擎评分——团队成色，一眼可见。
intro.en: AI agents are the most crowded lane in open source this year, and stars only tell you what's popular. We care about who's writing the code: every pick below ships with engine scores for its core contributors — team quality at a glance.

blurb.zh: 从 Clawdbot 一路更名杀出来的个人 AI 助理，跑在你自己的设备上。核心圈子极小但成色极高——我们的研报显示它是典型的"一人挑大梁"项目，作者本人就是引擎里的殿堂级账号。
blurb.en: The personal AI assistant that survived two renames and runs on your own devices. The core circle is tiny but exceptionally strong — our research shows a classic bus-factor-of-one project, and the author is a hall-of-fame account in our engine.

mock.description: Your own personal AI assistant — runs on your devices, answers on your channels.

blurb.zh: LLM 应用平台里工程化最扎实的一个。和明星项目常见的"一人项目"不同，Dify 背后是一支满编且分工清晰的全职团队——贡献者质量分布是我们扫过的项目里最健康的之一。
blurb.en: The most solidly engineered of the LLM app platforms. Unlike the usual one-person star project, Dify is built by a fully-staffed team with clear ownership — one of the healthiest contributor-quality distributions we've scanned.

mock.description: Production-ready platform for building agentic AI workflows.

blurb.zh: 让 Agent 真正会用浏览器的那个项目。增长曲线陡峭，但更值得注意的是核心维护者的响应质量——issue 处理速度和 PR 审查密度都在同类项目前列。
blurb.en: The project that actually taught agents to use a browser. The growth curve is steep, but what stands out is maintainer responsiveness — issue turnaround and PR review density lead the category.

mock.description: Make websites accessible for AI agents.

blurb.zh: 角色分工式多 Agent 编排的代表作。API 设计克制，文档质量高，社区贡献的门槛把控得很好——外围贡献者的平均分明显高于同规模项目。
blurb.en: The reference implementation for role-based multi-agent orchestration. Restrained API design, strong docs, and a well-guarded contribution bar — peripheral contributors score notably above same-size projects.

mock.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents.

blurb.zh: 大厂系多 Agent 框架里最活跃的一个。研究味重、迭代快，贡献者构成横跨 MSR 和社区——适合想看"论文思路如何落地成代码"的读者。
blurb.en: The most active of the big-company multi-agent frameworks. Research-flavored and fast-moving, with contributors spanning MSR and the community — ideal if you want to watch papers become code.

mock.description: A programming framework for agentic AI.
